summary: Iteration 186 Privacy Audit Sweep - FULL PASS (38/38 tests). Privacy guards for BOLA/IDOR protection verified. All positive paths (authorized access) and negative paths (404 for strangers) work correctly. Regression tests confirm existing News/Surveys/Meetings/Auth flows unbroken.
critical_code_review_comments: PRIVACY GUARDS WORKING: audience_guards.py correctly implements assert_can_view_news_post/survey/meeting
404 CONVENTION CORRECT: All unauthorized access returns 404 (not 403) to prevent existence leaks
NEWS POSITIVE PATHS: Admin/Moderator/Author/Targeted-User all get 200 on targeted posts
NEWS NEGATIVE PATHS: Strangers get 404 on targeted posts, comments, reactions
SURVEYS POSITIVE PATHS: Admin sees all, targeted users can view/respond, results visible after participation
SURVEYS NEGATIVE PATHS: Strangers get 404 on targeted surveys, 403 on results before participation
MEETINGS POSITIVE PATHS: Host/Admin can access all sub-resources (chat, polls, questions, breakout-rooms)
MEETINGS NEGATIVE PATHS: Strangers get 404 on meeting detail and all sub-resources
ADMIN REGRESSION: news/stats, interaction-stats, feedback/entries all working
seed_data_creation: Test users created with TEST_ prefix during testing, cleaned up after each test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 186 validated the Privacy Audit Sweep. Key implementation: /app/backend/services/audience_guards.py contains assert_can_view_news_post, assert_can_view_survey, assert_can_view_meeting helpers that raise HTTPException(404) on unauthorized access. These are called from detail endpoints in news/posts.py, surveys.py, and meetings/core.py. Convention: 404 is returned instead of 403 to prevent existence leaks (BOLA/IDOR protection). All positive paths (admin, moderator, author, targeted user, host, participant) continue to work. All negative paths (strangers) correctly receive 404.
